about: Figma source of truth for Game Core Style 2 (READY_UI_STYLE_2, id style-2): the LevelMap screen. Read 2026-10-01 through the Figma MCP (Pro team, Full seat): read-only use_figma dumps, download_assets (raw images, context SVGs, the reference render) and get_screenshot with contentsOnly (transparent renders). Coordinates are Figma units of the 4168 x 2344 screen frame = Ready UI design units (the frame is 2344 high like the portrait design box).

rasters: download_assets PNG exports of nodes WITHOUT export settings are composited over their context (page #F5F5F5, section #444444, the screen gradient) and come out fully opaque; get_screenshot with contentsOnly returns the same render with alpha (over the context it equals the opaque export: mean |delta| 0.005..0.4). Chrome's raster of Figma's SVG export differs on some effects (the plus glyph's drop shadow: mean 9.4), so every effect-bearing texture is Figma's own transparent render. The icon components (288 x 288) carry PNG@1x export settings: their exports are transparent and used as they are.
